path.expr: db.Exec("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ? WHERE user_id = ?", amount, userID)
db.Exec("UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + ? WHERE user_id = ?", amount, recipientID)

sanitizers.description: Constant SQL template with ? placeholders; tainted values bound as parameters
amount coerced to float64 via strconv.ParseFloat

notes: SQL injection is NOT exploitable — both db.Exec calls use constant templates with ? placeholders and pass tainted values as bound parameters; amount additionally undergoes numeric coercion. NOTE: this handler carries a separate, serious IDOR (any authenticated user can credit/debit arbitrary accounts via the attacker-controlled 'to' parameter and missing source-ownership check) plus missing balance/atomicity/amount-sign checks — handled by authz-findings.json and invariant-results.json.
